# aikido_task_tracking_code_repo_mapping (Resource)

Maps Aikido code repositories to task-tracker projects (Linear, Jira, and others). This is repository mapping, not Aikido team mapping; the public API can write repo-to-project links only. Define one resource per task-tracker integration. Omit integration_id when the workspace has a single integration. The Aikido API has no delete endpoint for this mapping, so destroying this resource only removes it from Terraform state and leaves the remote mapping unchanged.

This resource writes [Map code repo to task tracking projects](https://apidocs.aikido.dev/reference/maprepostoproject) and reads [Get project mapping](https://apidocs.aikido.dev/reference/getprojectmapping). Project IDs are those of the connected tracker (for Linear, the Linear team/project IDs). Repository IDs are Aikido code repository IDs.

-> This configures **repository** mapping (`mapping_mode = repos`). The public API cannot write Aikido **team** mapping (`mapping_mode = teams`). Applying this resource switches the integration to repository mapping.

-> Destroy does **not** unmap projects in Aikido. It only removes the resource from Terraform state.

Use a JSON file as the source of truth if you want to detect drift:

```terraform
resource "aikido_task_tracking_code_repo_mapping" "linear" {
  integration_id    = 2
  project_repos_map = jsondecode(file("${path.module}/linear-repo-map.json"))
}
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Maps Aikido code repositories to task-tracker projects (Linear, Jira, ...).
# This is repository mapping, not Aikido team mapping.
# Define one resource per task-tracker integration.
# Destroy only removes this resource from Terraform state; remote mappings stay as configured.
resource "aikido_task_tracking_code_repo_mapping" "linear" {
  integration_id = 2

  project_repos_map = {
    "10000" = [1, 2, 3]
    "10001" = [4, 6]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_repos_map` (Map of Set of Number) Map of task-tracker project IDs to Aikido code repository IDs. Project IDs are those of the connected tracker (for example Linear team IDs or Jira project IDs). An empty repository set unmaps that project. Projects omitted from the map are left unmapped in config; extra mapped projects in Aikido show as drift.

### Optional

- `integration_id` (Number) Task-tracker integration ID. Required when the workspace has more than one integration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Task tracking code-repo-to-project mapping identifier. The integration ID when set, otherwise a workspace-wide sentinel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import the workspace default mapping (no integration_id).
terraform import aikido_task_tracking_code_repo_mapping.linear task_tracking_code_repo_mapping

# Import a mapping for a specific task-tracker integration.
terraform import aikido_task_tracking_code_repo_mapping.linear 2
```
